title: BetterHelp Session Messages Exchanged Leaderboard
dataSources: SimplePractice therapy sessions (`simplepractice:session`), Headway appointments (`headway:appointment`), BetterHelp sessions (`betterhelp:session`), CBT homework logs (`cbt:homework`), and Daylio mood entries (`daylio:mood`).
app: SimplePractice session notes, Headway appointment confirmations, BetterHelp messaging sessions, CBT homework trackers, and Daylio mood exports ingested into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=betterhelp:session message_count=*
| stats sum(message_count) as total_value, avg(message_count) as avg_value by counselor_name
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks counselor values by total and average messages exchanged across BetterHelp session events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `message_count` values for each BetterHelp session event and review total and average messages exchanged by counselor.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total messages exchanged.
grandmaExplanation: It celebrates which counselor shows the biggest messages exchanged numbers in your BetterHelp session data.
